verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this story applies to the Ohio Secretary of State. The evidence pack contains nothing about an API, an OpenAPI document, or any equivalent spec. The Gateway and tax pages describe only human-facing portal features and help guides, and the probes show the SoS hosts return 403 even for robots.txt. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability yields "none".
